bagPolicy.summary: Pitchfork Music Festival is not scheduled in Chicago for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site still shows the 2024 festival and lists no newer dates. Per NBC News, Nov. 11, 2024, the festival said it would not return to Chicago in 2025. Last published rule (2024): small purses, satchels, fanny packs and drawstring bags up to 14" x 11" x 5"; no multi-pocket backpacks or bags.

parking.note: No current Chicago festival transportation or parking plan is published. Do not use historical review-site directions as current event guidance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Pitchfork Music Festival's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: No current Chicago festival food-and-beverage program is published. Consult the official site if a future edition is announced.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Pitchfork Music Festival, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Pitchfork Music Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Pitchfork Music Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Pitchfork Music Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
